title: NovAI API Documentation - OpenAI-Compatible China AI API

sections.title: Overview
sections.text: NovAI is an AI API gateway based in Hong Kong, offering low-latency access to Chinese AI models through a unified, OpenAI-compatible interface.
alerts: NovAI supports both the Chat Completions API ( /v1/chat/completions ) and the new Responses API ( /v1/responses ). We are the only platform offering Responses API access to Chinese AI models.

sections.title: Authentication
sections.text: All API requests require an API key passed via the Authorization header: Authorization: Bearer nvai-your-api-key-here Get your API key by signing up at aiapi-pro.com . Registration requires only an email address.

code_blocks.code: Authorization: Bearer nvai-your-api-key-here

sections.title: Base URL
sections.text: https://aiapi-pro.com/v1 Replace https://api.openai.com/v1 with the URL above in any existing OpenAI integration.

sections.title: Responses API NEW — EXCLUSIVE
sections.text: POST /v1/responses NovAI is the first and only API platform supporting OpenAI's new Responses API for Chinese AI models. This enables tools like Open Cowork, OpenAI Agents SDK, and any Responses API-based application to use GLM-5, MiniMax, and more China-exclusive models.
alerts: Why this matters: Chinese AI providers (Zhipu, MiniMax) only support the legacy /v1/chat/completions endpoint. NovAI automatically translates Responses API format to Chat Completions format, making Chinese models accessible to all modern agent tools.

code_blocks.code:
curl https://aiapi-pro.com/v1/responses \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nvai-your-key" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "glm-5",
    "input": "Explain quantum computing simply.",
    "stream": false
  }'

sections.title: Compatible Tools
sections.text: The following tools work out of the box with NovAI's Responses API endpoint: Read the full guide: Responses API for Chinese Models →

sections.title: Embeddings NEW
sections.text: POST /v1/embeddings Creates a vector representation of the input, powered by Tencent Kinfra embedding models. Text models return 1024–2560 dimension vectors; multimodal (VL) models embed text, images and video in one shared space for cross-modal retrieval.

rows: Text models: a string or list of strings. Multimodal (VL) models: an object array such as [{"type":"text","text":"..."}] or [{"type":"image_url","image_url":"..."}]

code_blocks.code:
curl https://aiapi-pro.com/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nvai-your-key" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "kinfra-text-embedding-4b",
    "input": "The quick brown fox"
  }'

curl https://aiapi-pro.com/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nvai-your-key" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "kinfra-vl-embedding-8b",
    "input": [{"type": "text", "text": "a cat sitting on a mat"}]
  }'

sections.title: Example Response
sections.text: { "object": "list", "data": [ {"object": "embedding", "index": 0, "embedding": [0.0023, -0.0091, ...]} ], "model": "kinfra-text-embedding-4b", "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 5, "total_tokens": 5} } Billing: only input tokens are charged (at the per-1M rate above); the returned vectors are free.

sections.title: Image Generation NEW
sections.text: POST /v1/images/generations Generates images from a text prompt, powered by Tencent Hunyuan, Vidu, ByteDance Seedream and WAND Vega image models via the TokenHub gateway. Returns an OpenAI-compatible {created, data:[{url}]} response. Even for models that are asynchronous upstream, NovAI polls to completion internally and returns the final image URL synchronously.

sections.title: Available models
alerts: TokenHub image models are billed by actual upstream token usage ( usage.total_tokens × token price), not a flat per-image fee. The per-image prices above are reference values at base resolution and scale with resolution and reference-image count. Legacy flat-price models ( doubao-seedream-4.5 , doubao-seedream-4.0 , cogview-3-flash ) keep their original pricing.

rows: Text description of the image to generate
Number of images to generate (1–4, default 1)
Image size as WxH (e.g. 1024x1024 ). Mapped to each vendor's allowed sizes / aspect ratios.
Reference image URL(s) for image-to-image editing (count limit varies by model)

code_blocks.code:
curl https://aiapi-pro.com/v1/images/generations \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nvai-your-key" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "hy-image-v3",
    "prompt": "a cute orange cat on a windowsill, soft sunlight",
    "size": "1024x1024",
    "n": 1
  }'

curl https://aiapi-pro.com/v1/images/generations \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nvai-your-key" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "vidu-image-q2",
    "prompt": "change the background to a snowy mountain",
    "images": ["https://example.com/input.jpg"],
    "size": "1024x1024"
  }'

sections.title: Example Response
sections.text: { "created": 1730000000, "data": [ {"url": "https://.../generated-image.png"} ], "usage": {"total_tokens": 20000} } Billing: the response usage.total_tokens reflects the real upstream token count; the charge is total_tokens / 1000 × token_price . For example, hy-image-v3 at 1024² returns ~20000 tokens ≈ $0.031. Async upstream models (Vidu, WAND Vega) are polled to completion (up to ~180s) before the URL is returned.

sections.title: Audio NEW
sections.text: Two OpenAI-compatible audio endpoints powered by MiniMax and Tencent models via the TokenHub gateway: /v1/audio/speech (text → audio: TTS + music) and /v1/audio/transcriptions (audio → text: ASR). Both are synchronous.

sections.title: Transcription models — POST /v1/audio/transcriptions
alerts: All audio models are billed by actual upstream token usage at $1.54 / 1M tokens (10元/M upstream — the same rate as image and video). The per-unit prices above are references: TTS scales with text length (~20–35 tokens/char), music is ~100k tokens/song, ASR scales with audio duration.

rows: Speech or music model ID (see tables above)
Text to speak (TTS). For music models pass lyrics and prompt instead.
mp3 (default, binary audio), wav / opus / aac / flac / pcm , or url (NovAI extension: JSON with an audio_url ).
Music models only: song lyrics and style prompt.

code_blocks.code:
curl https://aiapi-pro.com/v1/audio/speech \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nvai-your-key" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "minimax-speech-2.8-hd",
    "input": "Hello, welcome to NovAI.",
    "voice": "male-qn-qingse",
    "response_format": "url"
  }'

sections.title: Example Response (response_format=url)
sections.text: { "id": "audgen-...", "model": "minimax-speech-2.8-hd", "status": "completed", "audio_url": "https://.../speech/....mp3", "usage": {"total_tokens": 1505, "characters": 43} } With the default response_format=mp3 the endpoint instead streams raw audio bytes ( Content-Type: audio/mpeg ), exactly like OpenAI’s native /v1/audio/speech — so the OpenAI SDK works unchanged.

code_blocks.code:
# JSON form: transcribe from a URL
curl https://aiapi-pro.com/v1/audio/transcriptions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nvai-your-key" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model": "wand-asr-v1", "file_url": "https://example.com/audio.mp3"}'

# OpenAI multipart form: upload a file
curl https://aiapi-pro.com/v1/audio/transcriptions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nvai-your-key" \
  -F model=hy-asr-3.0-preview \
  -F [email protected]

sections.title: Example Response (transcription)
sections.text: { "text": "Hello, welcome to NovAI.", "language": "en", "duration_ms": 2426, "sentences": [{"begin_ms": 0, "end_ms": 2426, "text": "Hello, welcome to NovAI."}], "subtitle_url": "https://.../....srt", "usage": {"total_tokens": 121} } Billing: the charge is usage.total_tokens / 1000 × token_price (token_price = $0.0015385/1K). Transcription accepts either a multipart file upload (OpenAI-native) or a JSON file_url / base64 data field.

sections.title: Video Generation NEW
sections.text: POST /v1/video/generations + GET /v1/video/generations/{id} Generates video from a text prompt (and optional source image), powered by MiniMax Hailuo and Tencent Hunyuan video models via the TokenHub gateway. Video generation is asynchronous : submit a task to get an id , then poll the GET endpoint until status is succeeded (the mp4 is in video_url ) or failed (auto-refunded).

sections.title: Available models
alerts: TokenHub video models are billed by actual upstream token usage at $1.54 / 1M tokens (10元/M upstream — the same rate as image and audio). The per-second values above are references. At submit an estimate ( tokens/s × duration ) is pre-deducted; when the task succeeds the charge is reconciled to the real tokenhub_usage.total_tokens (over-estimate refunded, under-estimate topped up). Per-second-billed models ( doubao-seedance-2.5 , doubao-seedance-2.0 , doubao-seedance-2.0-fast ) and the free cogvideox-flash are also served by this endpoint and keep their original pricing.

rows: Text description of the video to generate
Source image URL for image-to-video. Required for minimax-video-v2.3-fast (I2V-only).

code_blocks.code:
curl https://aiapi-pro.com/v1/video/generations \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nvai-your-key" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "minimax-video-h3",
    "prompt": "A red sports car driving along a coastal road at sunset, cinematic",
    "resolution": "720p",
    "duration": 5,
    "ratio": "16:9"
  }'

curl https://aiapi-pro.com/v1/video/generations \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nvai-your-key" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "hy-video-v1.5",
    "prompt": "Animate this scene with smooth cinematic motion",
    "image": "https://example.com/first-frame.jpg",
    "duration": 5
  }'

{
  "id": "<task_id>",
  "status": "queued",
  "model": "minimax-video-h3",
  "resolution": "720p",
  "duration": 5
}

curl "https://aiapi-pro.com/v1/video/generations/<task_id>?model=minimax-video-h3" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nvai-your-key"

sections.title: Example Response (poll, completed)
sections.text: { "id": "<task_id>", "status": "succeeded", "video_url": "https://.../output.mp4", "video_result": [{"url": "https://.../output.mp4"}], "duration": 5, "tokenhub_usage": {"total_tokens": 250000}, "novai_token_settlement": { "prepaid_usd": 0.384625, "actual_usd": 0.384625, "adjustment_usd": 0.0, "total_tokens": 250000 } } Billing: while status is queued / processing keep polling (generation typically takes 1–5 minutes). On succeeded the pre-deducted estimate is reconciled to the real token count and novai_token_settlement reports the adjustment. On failed / cancelled the pre-deducted amount is automatically refunded.

sections.title: 3D Generation NEW
sections.text: POST /v1/three_d/generations + GET /v1/three_d/generations/{id} Generates a 3D model (mesh) from a text prompt and/or a source image, powered by Tencent Hunyuan 3D and Tripo (VAST) models via the TokenHub gateway. 3D generation is asynchronous : submit a task to get an id , then poll the GET endpoint until status is succeeded (downloadable model URLs are in outputs , primary in model_url ) or failed (auto-refunded).

sections.title: Available models
alerts: Unlike image/video/audio (which are billed by upstream token usage), TokenHub 3D models are billed upstream by credits and return no token usage on query. NovAI therefore charges a flat per-generation price (default tier): the full price is pre-deducted at submit and refunded in full if the job fails or is cancelled — you only pay for successful generations. Only the default generation mode is exposed (no PBR / high-poly / extra-format upcharges), so the flat price always matches the upstream cost.

rows: Text description of the 3D asset. Required for text-to-3D; at least one of prompt / image must be provided.
Source image URL for image-to-3D. Required for hy-3d-polygen-image .

code_blocks.code:
curl https://aiapi-pro.com/v1/three_d/generations \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nvai-your-key" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "hy-3d-3.1",
    "prompt": "a cute cartoon dog"
  }'

curl https://aiapi-pro.com/v1/three_d/generations \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nvai-your-key" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "tripo-3d-3.1",
    "image": "https://example.com/object.png"
  }'

curl "https://aiapi-pro.com/v1/three_d/generations/<task_id>?model=hy-3d-3.1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nvai-your-key"

sections.title: Example Response (poll, completed)
sections.text: { "id": "<task_id>", "status": "succeeded", "upstream_status": "completed", "model_url": "https://.../model.glb", "outputs": [ {"type": "obj", "url": "https://.../model.obj.zip", "preview_image_url": "https://.../preview.png"}, {"type": "glb", "url": "https://.../model.glb", "preview_image_url": "https://.../preview.png"} ], "model": "hy-3d-3.1" } Billing: while status is queued / processing keep polling (generation typically takes 1–8 minutes). On succeeded the flat pre-deducted price is final (no token reconciliation). On failed / cancelled the pre-deducted amount is automatically refunded ( novai_refund is reported in the response). model_url is the primary downloadable asset (glb preferred); outputs lists every available format.

sections.title: Streaming
sections.text: Set "stream": true to receive responses as Server-Sent Events (SSE): curl https://aiapi-pro.com/v1/chat/completions \ -H "Authorization: Bearer nvai-your-key" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "model": "glm-5", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}], "stream": true }' Each SSE event contains a JSON chunk with delta.content for the new token. The stream ends with [DONE] .

code_blocks.code:
curl https://aiapi-pro.com/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nvai-your-key" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "glm-5",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}],
    "stream": true
  }'

sections.title: SDKs & Libraries
sections.text: NovAI works with any OpenAI-compatible SDK. Just set the base URL:

code_blocks.code:
pip install openai

from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(api_key="nvai-...", base_url="https://aiapi-pro.com/v1")

from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI
llm = ChatOpenAI(model="glm-5", openai_api_key="nvai-...", openai_api_base="https://aiapi-pro.com/v1")

sections.title: Cursor IDE / Continue
sections.text: Set base URL to https://aiapi-pro.com/v1 in your IDE settings. See our Cursor setup guide . More examples: GitHub Repository | Blog & Tutorials
